formIdentityNote: One official binary, used as published: District Court Motion, Affidavit and Instructions to Expunge or Seal Record, DC-33 (revised February 2025). Rhode Island publishes one motion-and-affidavit form per court and carries every statutory branch as a numbered Part of one affidavit, so this family binds DC-33 and builds on Part Three A: Single Conviction. No form number is invented and no order identity is acquired.
